rationale: Shared: detectors, label-alignment screen, corpus F@g regression with 0.3/0.15 dependence flags. A uses seeded template-generator minimal pairs, cue rule |dF@g|>=1.25, same-sign ranking under cumulative topic cap, probe_scores ablation checks. B uses hand-edited string-replacement pairs, corpus-dependence upper-bound null rule, pooled-regression latent attribution with grid search over caps/splits, offline evaluation only.
